summary: Prepare traceable carbon project monitoring records, calculations, and evidence packages. Explore the five-day course and course outline.
lede: Carbon project MRV training helps project developers and MRV practitioners turn methodology requirements into traceable monitoring evidence. Participants practise preparing a project evidence package by drafting sampling and quality-control procedures, checking field, geospatial and remote-sensing data, and recording calculation assumptions. They also organize monitoring-report evidence and draft responses to assessment findings, with attention to programme requirements and version transitions.
audienceIntro: This course suits intermediate practitioners who already contribute to carbon project design, monitoring, carbon accounting, or evidence preparation. It is designed for people who need to connect methodology requirements with field procedures, project records, calculations, and independent assessment readiness.
prerequisites: Prior work on carbon project development, monitoring, carbon accounting, or project evidence is expected. You should be comfortable reviewing project records and using spreadsheets. No coding or programming is required; GIS experience is useful for roles handling spatial data.
